title: Leni Robredo clarifies P500-M grant for Naga coliseum repair
summary: Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo has issued a statement surrounding the P500-million national funding allocated for the repair, retrofitting, and upgrading of the Jesse M. Robredo Coliseum.
